findings.passage: Texans deserve elections they can trust. I will fight to ban hackable machines, clean up voter rolls, and make sure only citizens can vote.
findings.note: Under the heading Restore Election Integrity on his campaign platform page. The date is the page's last-modified date. He names voter-roll cleanup and citizen-only voting as goals. No detail on ID documents.

findings.motion: HB 2332, citizenship shown on ID cards and licenses and used in election processes (filed and referred to the Elections committee)
findings.note: He is the author. The bill relates to how a personal identification certificate or driver's license issued to a U.S. citizen appears, and to using it in certain election processes. It was referred to committee on 2025-03-14.

findings.motion: HB 1312, proof of citizenship to verify eligibility to vote: coauthor (referred to Elections committee)
findings.note: He is one of the House coauthors of HB 1312, relating to a person submitting proof of citizenship to verify eligibility to vote in Texas. The bill was referred to committee on 2025-03-10.

findings.motion: SJR 37, constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen: listed as House cosponsor
findings.note: He is listed among the House cosponsors of SJR 37, a proposed constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen. The bill history shows it filed with the Secretary of State on 2025-05-15.

findings.motion: SJR 37, constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen: adopted by the House, Record 2196, 102 yeas, 14 nays, 22 present not voting
findings.note: The House Journal lists Hopper among the yeas on final House adoption of SJR 37, the proposed amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen.
